The lessons continue as Pogo accidentally ruins Newt's teddy-shaped hedge and learns to tell the truth, and Fuse finds the courage to eat his healthy Oddsprouts!

Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world and beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi and FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon and discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

Blippi is learning awesome facts about all kinds of animals! He and D.BO travel back in time to meet the biggest dinosaurs, like the Argentinosaurus, and even try to keep a T-Rex as a pet for a day! Back in the present, they shrink down to count a shark's teeth with a pilot fish dentist. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how elephants use their trunks to keep cool and discovers why cats have whiskers from a local feline celebrity.

It's the ultimate pretend play day with JJ! When the cookies go missing, it's up to Detective JJ and his sidekick Bingo to follow the clues and solve the case. Then, when JJ gets nervous on his first carousel ride, Mom helps him unlock his imagination and he becomes a brave knight on a valiant steed! The pretend play continues as Captain JJ and first mate YoYo set sail on the high seas to find a lost sock. From playing chef to being a Turtle Scout, you can be anything!

Ahoy, mateys! Join JJ for pirate songs and fun beach games! The adventure begins when JJ and Wally play pirates on the high seas but can't agree on where to find the hidden treasure! Then, when a wave washes away their sandcastle, a little crab helps them try again to build one that's nearly indestructible. The pirate fun continues as Wally tries to swipe JJ's five little duckies during bath time, leading to a sudsy chase to find the ducknapper!
Axels birthday celebration is interrupted when HTDT mistakenly yolk-blasts King Blanco. The trio of villains (BBC) causes chaos with a catatonic accomplice while the heroes try to save the party.

HTDT and Axel watch a beauty pageant where a trailer trash Snow White competes. Arisa joins the event, which ends with an unlikely winner, Bertha, being crowned as the heroes navigate the pageant's vanity.

As Deedee and Nino were wondering what Charlie got the twins for their birthday, Sandy whizzes past in a brand new pedal car. Boris got one too, but he doesn’t want his to get dirty at all. So he decides not to use it at all even though he misses all the fun Sandy is having. Mewmew and Sandy even have a race across town. Boris even declines a chance to race, but is entirely sceptical about it as he doesn’t even want a splash of mud to fall on it. He is even more worried when he sees Sandy’s car not working. Deedee tries to help by magically trying to create a bubble guard around Boris’s car, but the spell falls on Sandy’s car instead. Now no one can even touch the car, let alone repair it. Boris vouches to allow Sandy use his car as he acknowledges that it was his undoing that led to the creation of the bubble in the first place. Sandy is overjoyed and promises to be extra careful. So careful that Mewmew can even beat her by running on his ears. Deedee tells Boris to prove to Sandy that she can use the car faster, so Boris races with Mewmew and accidentally splashes mud over his face, but then is happy he does and enjoys the fun. He races so fast that he pops the bubble guard over Sandy’s car by crashing into it. Charlie sets down to fix the cars and the twins are driving them in a jiffy, giggling all the way.
Charlie is found napping on the job. Deedee and Nino encourage him as being the best postman ever and that anyone would doze off in the sweltering heat.

WI-Go the traveler is starving and has nothing but his brain. He ends up making the most delicious soup in the world using a mysterious stone without using a single penny.

Mischievous UGo takes all of his parents' property and kicks his younger brother GoGo out of the house. Meanwhile, a swallow bird brings a gourd seed to the eaves of a kind-hearted GoGo house, and soon, gourds containing gold and silver treasures opens on the roof of the GoGo's house.

In the cold winter, the kindhearted girl, GoGo, meets several people who feel sorry for her on her way home. A fairy queen appears in front of a GoGGo that distributes all her clothes and bread and shakes in the cold.

p.t: Most Haunted - S19:E06 - Oak House, West Bromwich
p.d: Radio host Glen Hunt, who's usually a sceptic, starts to question his beliefs after joining the Most Haunted crew at Oak House, a 16th-century farmhouse with timber frames in West Bromwich.

p.t: Most Haunted - S20:E01 - Abbey House Museum, Leeds
p.d: Yvette, Karl, and their crew are back to explore more allegedly haunted spots. This time, they've got Yvette's bulldog Watson tagging along as they check out ghost stories at the Abbey House Museum in Leeds.

p.t: Most Haunted - S20:E02 - Wentworth Woodhouse Stables
p.d: The team return to the vast country house Wentworth Woodhouse, near Rotherham to investigate part of the property they did not explore during their 2015 visit to the site - the large stable block.
